response.query: How will teacher workload be quantified (time per lesson, review time per generated text) and what feasibility/fidelity triggers will we set?
response.answer: Teacher workload will be quantified by time per lesson and review time per generated text. Feasibility/fidelity triggers will be set based on institutional standards and educational outcomes. Current guidelines suggest a balanced approach to ensure quality teaching and manageable workloads.
